name: threejs-shaders
title_zh: Three.js 着色器：从零写 GLSL 自定义特
tagline_zh: 想给 3D 场景加个会呼吸的波纹、顶点扭曲或发光边缘？不用再翻文档拼凑，直接照着 GLSL 的写法。
tagline_en: Want breathing waves, vertex twists, or glowing edges in Three.js? Stop hunting docs — get ShaderMaterial +.
desc_en: Three.js shaders - GLSL, ShaderMaterial, uniforms, custom effects. Use when creating custom visual effects, modifying vertices, writing fragment shaders, or extending built-in materials.
why_zh: 它把 GLSL 的坑提前填平：内置常见特效模板，uniform 类型与 Three.js 绑定方式直接。
why_en: Pre-flattens GLSL pitfalls: ships ready effect templates, maps uniform types straight to Three.js bindings — tweak and run, no.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 的 ShaderMaterial 与 RawShaderMaterial。
limit_en: Only ShaderMaterial/RawShaderMaterial; no EffectComposer post-processing, no GLSL basics. Multi-pass or custom render targets? It stops there.
